investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (HTTP 409)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T21:58:29–32Z with an identical HTTP 409 response from POST /api/agents: the swarm backend rejected the creation request because the agent quota for the eval org has reached its hard limit of 100. Because agent creation is the first step in every remote-agents check, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, causing a complete contract gap across the entire feature group.
investigation.rootCause: The production swarm backend returned HTTP 409 with error code "conflict" and message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" when the eval runner called POST /api/agents. This prevented agent creation from succeeding, so the eval probe never advanced past the creation step and produced zero evidence. Because all three sibling checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) share the same agent-creation dependency and all carry the identical 409 error message, the quota exhaustion is the single upstream blocker for the entire remote-agents feature group in the production-api runtime environment. This is an eval-infrastructure failure against the production API; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigation.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on /api/generate/image/stream in production-api
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying a 404 status, indicating the agent runtime harness endpoint was unreachable when the eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream. Because the session could not be opened, the stream never emitted a generation_completed frame and no image URL was produced, causing both required contract assertions to fail.
investigation.rootCause: The agent runtime harness backing /api/generate/image/stream returned a 404 at session-open time in the production-api environment. The stream emitted a generation_error frame with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version." This is an eval-infrastructure or runtime-configuration failure localized to the production-api harness endpoint; no evidence of user-traffic or production incident signals is present in the packet, so impact is scoped to this observability eval only.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (HTTP 409)
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T21:58:29–32Z with an identical HTTP 409 response from POST /api/agents: the swarm backend rejected the creation request because the agent quota for the eval org has reached its hard limit of 100. Because agent creation is the first step in every remote-agents check, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, causing a complete contract gap across the entire feature group.
investigations.rootCause: The production swarm backend returned HTTP 409 with error code "conflict" and message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" when the eval runner called POST /api/agents. This prevented agent creation from succeeding, so the eval probe never advanced past the creation step and produced zero evidence. Because all three sibling checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) share the same agent-creation dependency and all carry the identical 409 error message, the quota exhaustion is the single upstream blocker for the entire remote-agents feature group in the production-api runtime environment. This is an eval-infrastructure failure against the production API; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

Less likely but possible: a prior eval run created agents that were not cleaned up (withCleanup in run-status-probes.mjs may have failed silently), causing agents to accumulate against the quota over multiple runs.

investigations.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on /api/generate/image/stream in production-api
investigations.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying a 404 status, indicating the agent runtime harness endpoint was unreachable when the eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream. Because the session could not be opened, the stream never emitted a generation_completed frame and no image URL was produced, causing both required contract assertions to fail.
investigations.rootCause: The agent runtime harness backing /api/generate/image/stream returned a 404 at session-open time in the production-api environment. The stream emitted a generation_error frame with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version." This is an eval-infrastructure or runtime-configuration failure localized to the production-api harness endpoint; no evidence of user-traffic or production incident signals is present in the packet, so impact is scoped to this observability eval only.
